seo.description: Study Bachelor's in Civil Engineering in Australia for Indian students. Learn about top universities (Curtin, ECU, Flinders), eligibility, fees, Engineers Australia accreditation, and career opportunities.

hero.title: undergraduate civil engineering in Australia.
hero.subtitle: Civil engineering focuses on the design, construction, and maintenance of the built and natural environments, including roads, bridges, buildings, water supply systems, and transport networks.

overview: Civil engineering education in Australia prepares students for leadership in structural design, geotechnical engineering, transport networks, water resources, and sustainable construction management.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to pursue undergraduate degrees in civil engineering in Australia?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualified Indian students can apply after completing Class 12 with required mathematics and science subjects.

faq.question: How long does it take to earn a degree in civil engineering in Australia?
faq.answer: A standard Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) requires 4 years of full-time study.

faq.question: Does civil engineering require mathematics?
faq.answer: Yes, mathematics is a compulsory prerequisite for admission to Australian civil engineering programs.

faq.question: Does Australia's Civil Engineering program require NEET?
faq.answer: No, NEET is not required for engineering programs in Australia.

faq.question: In Class 12, what percentage is necessary?
faq.answer: Minimum academic requirements vary by university, typically ranging between 65% and 80% aggregate.
